title: ContextMap
description: The bounded contexts the language of the modules suggests, the relation between them, and what could not be placed

reasoning.description: Overall reasoning: how the contexts were derived from the shared vocabulary, the intruding terms and the quadrant of language and imports

contexts.description: One entry per bounded context candidate

name.description: A short name for the context, taken from the language that holds it together

modules.description: The modules that speak this context, named as the analysis reports them

language.description: The terms that hold the context together

reasoning.description: Why these modules belong to one context: the shared terms and the imports that support the grouping

relations.description: One entry per relation between two contexts. A project with a single context has no relation.

fromContext.description: The context the relation starts at

toContext.description: The context the relation points at

relation.description: The named relation between the two contexts

evidence.description: The counted evidence the relation rests on: the import count and the shared leading terms of the pair, or the quadrant classification it reads

sharedLanguage.description: Whether the pair shares leading candidate terms, as the overview reports it

structurallyCoupled.description: Whether the pair imports each other, as the overview reports it

unplacedModules.description: The modules that could not be placed in a context, with the reason

module.description: The module that was not placed

reason.description: Why it was not placed, for example that its vocabulary is too small to judge or that it shares no language with any other module
